name: apple_status
title: Apple Bridge status
description: Your access (level and scopes), which Apple sources are ready, and the Mac's time zone and time. Use it when a source is empty or refused.

name: apple_describe
title: Find operations
description: Find what you can do. query: the best operations for a task in plain words, such as search notes, each with arguments and an example call. domain: that domain's operations. operation: one operation's full contract. No arguments: a short overview.

domain.description: Domain name, such as reminders or messages.

name: apple_search
title: Search Apple data
description: Search the owner's data for text: contacts, messages, notes, mail, reminders, calendar, files, voicemail and more, grouped by source with ids; more and skipped say which sources have more or were not searched. Photos: photos_find.

sources.description: Only these sources, such as notes, mail, calendar or messages, or a collection such as notes.note. Default all you can read.

after.description: A source's value from more, for its next page; set sources to that one source.

name: apple_read
title: Read Apple data
description: Run a read operation. Common, arguments optional unless shown: reminders.list {"list":"Groceries"} or {"smart":"today"}; notes.search {"text":"ferry"}; mail.search {"text":"invoice"}. apple_describe gives other arguments. reads runs up to 10 reads at once.

fields.description: Keep only these data fields in each record.

reads.description: Instead of operation: up to 10 reads, results in order.

request_id.description: For reads the owner must approve: repeat with the same request_id after approval.

verbose.description: The full result with sync details.

view.description: reminders.list smart today: one group in full.

name: apple_change
title: Change Apple data
description: Run an operation that changes data; apple_describe gives its arguments. Waits up to 15 seconds; status is done (with ids and the changed record), partial (see parts), pending, awaiting_approval, failed or indeterminate. Updates and deletes need expected_version: the record's version.

arguments.description: Its arguments, with expected_version where needed.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change: up to 120 letters, digits and ._:-. Reuse it to retry safely.

verbose.description: Include the full history and the Mac's raw result.

name: apple_command_status
title: Check a change
description: Check a change that came back pending or indeterminate by its request_id. Returns the same result as apple_change.

request_id.description: The request_id from apple_change or another changing tool.

verbose.description: Include the full history and the Mac's raw result.

name: apple_guide
title: Read a guide
description: Read a how-to. No name: a short overview of the tools and operation names. Guides: core, setup, messages, reminders-calendar, photos, files.

name: messages_read
title: Read messages
description: Read Messages. No arguments: recent chats with unread counts, without spam or unknown senders (unread: unread chats of the last 30 days). with: a person's chat by number, email or name, group chats as other_chats. chat_id: that chat; unread starts at the first unread, before pages back. text: messages with these words in any chat.

with.description: Phone number, email or contact name of the other person.

chat_id.description: A cht_ chat ID from an earlier result.

text.description: Words to find in messages, across all chats. Not with with or chat_id.

unread.description: Only unread chats or messages; in a chat, start at the first unread message.

senders.description: Chat lists: all adds spam, unknown senders and old unread.

before.description: In a chat: the before value from the previous result, for older messages.

after.description: For text results: the after value from the previous result.

name: messages_send
title: Send a message
description: Send an iMessage, SMS or RCS. to: phone number, email or contact name, used only if it matches one person and one chat, otherwise you get candidates; or chat_id from messages_read, also for groups. Text is sent exactly as given. done means the Mac shows it sent, not that it was delivered.

to.description: Phone number in international form, email, or a contact's name.

chat_id.description: An existing chat's cht_ ID. Use instead of to.

text.description: Message text, sent exactly as given. Optional with photos.

photos.description: asset_ids from photos_find; attaches the photo files.

service.description: Only for a number or email without an existing chat. Default iMessage.

request_id.description: Your ID for this send; repeating it never sends twice.

name: reminders_add
title: Add a reminder
description: Add a reminder. list: a list name or lst_ ID; default the first list. Returns its id. To complete, change or delete it: apple_change reminders.complete, reminders.update or reminders.delete with reminder set to its title.

list.description: List name, such as Groceries, or a lst_ ID.

due.description: Due time as RFC 3339, such as 2026-11-12T09:00:00-06:00, or a date YYYY-MM-DD.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change; repeating it never adds twice.

name: calendar_events
title: List calendar events
description: List calendar events, all-day ones included, with start_local and end_local in the Mac's time zone. Default today; date for one day, or start and end; text filters by title, notes or location; calendar by name or cal_ ID.

end.description: Range end, exclusive, RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD.

calendar.description: Only this calendar: its name, such as Work, or cal_ ID.

name: calendar_add
title: Add a calendar event
description: Add a calendar event. calendar: a name, such as Work, or cal_ ID; default the first writable calendar. Times without an offset are in the Mac's time zone; a start date YYYY-MM-DD makes an all-day event. Returns its id.

start.description: Start, such as 2026-11-12T15:00 or 2026-11-12T15:00:00-06:00, or a date YYYY-MM-DD for all day.

end.description: End, after start. Default one hour after start, or the same day for all day.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change; repeating it never adds twice.

name: contacts_find
title: Find a contact
description: Find people by name (any word order, accents and case ignored), phone number or email. Returns up to 25 contacts with phones, emails and con_ IDs.

query.description: A name such as Ana Novak, part of a name, a phone number or an email.

name: notes_create
title: Create a note
description: Create a plain-text note, kept exactly as given. folder: a folder name or fld_ ID; default the Notes folder. Returns its id.

request_id.description: Your ID for this change; repeating it never creates twice.

name: screen_time
title: Screen Time
description: Screen Time per device (Mac, iPhone, iPad): total and top apps, estimated from app focus. Default yesterday; date for one day, or start and end.

date.description: One day as YYYY-MM-DD. Default yesterday.

start.description: First day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD.

end.description: Last day of a range, inclusive.

device.description: Only this device, by part of its name, such as iPhone.

name: photos_find
title: Find photos
description: Find photos by date, type, album, favorite or place: a numbered grid only for you to scan (never show it), with each number's asset_id. One match returns the photo itself.

start.description: Taken on or after, RFC 3339 or YYYY-MM-DD.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the last result, same filters.

places.description: Instead list places photos were taken, with dates, counts and an asset_id each.

name: photos_show
title: Show a photo
description: The photo itself, to show the person: full frame and resolution, nothing drawn on it.

save.description: Also save the original file on the Mac; returns its path as file.
